title: KTM 390 Duke meets Star Wars : Holy Shift : Episode 4 : PowerDrift
description: With the freedom to let their imagination run wild, Harsha and Rohit decide to live out their Star Wars fantasy with the KTM 390 Duke. Called Bobba, this scrambler build is set to undergo a complete overhaul with major revisions to the subframe, brand new front suspension, a power boost for the engine and a performance exhaust. Even the styling is being given a wild and futuristic look to match the character of Boba Fett, one of the most feared bounty hunters from Star Wars.
